options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Story missions required for finale
options.doc:
Story checks needed for Mars Attacks, including Marauder Temple.
The finale needs no sector item; 21 requires all preceding story checks.

options.name: Start with fast travel
options.doc: Start with Guerrilla Express. All safehouses are available from the start.

options.doc: Show the reward item and recipient in each shopsanity purchase description.

options.name: Ore deposit checks
options.doc: One sector-gated check for each of the 300 ore deposits.

options.doc: One sector-gated check for each of the 54 propaganda billboards.

options.doc: One sector-gated check for each of the 36 radio tags.

options.name: EDF supply crate checks
options.doc: One sector-gated check for each of the 419 campaign EDF supply crates.

options.name: Collectible map markers
options.doc: Show unfinished enabled collectibles on the map in unlocked sectors.

options.name: Vehicle spawn costs
options.doc: Charge 50 salvage for unarmed vehicles, 100 for armed vehicles, and 200 for walkers and gunships.
options.doc_fr: Chargez 50 pour les véhicules non armés, 100 pour les véhicules armés et 200 pour les marcheurs et les navires.

options.name: Gunship unlock
options.doc: Separate gunship and bomber AP items, or one garage purchase unlocking both.

options.name: Gunship purchase cost
options.doc: Price to unlock gunships and bomber together. Includes the first spawn.
